voices.speaker: Jozef
voices.text: So you're Martin. Come inside, I'll show you what you'll be doing here. It's nothing complicated. Just watch the doors, write down your rounds, and never leave anything unlocked.

voices.speaker: Jozef
voices.text: Step over here by the desk and take a good look around the office so you know where everything sits.

voices.speaker: Jozef
voices.text: Everything important is written down in here. I don't expect you to remember the whole estate from memory. Open your notebook, check the map, and try writing a quick note.

voices.speaker: Jozef
voices.text: Your belt holds your torch, keys, radio, notebook, and taser. Scroll the mouse wheel or use the number keys to switch gear, and keep empty hands when you don't need tools.

voices.speaker: Jozef
voices.text: When something breaks down, your flashlight will save you. Take it out, switch it on and off, and shine it across a couple of things in here.

voices.speaker: Jozef
voices.text: Opening a door and unlocking it aren't the same thing. Take out your keys, look at the handle, try locking and unlocking it, and step through.

voices.speaker: Jozef
voices.text: Grab your handheld radio and run a quick channel check so dispatch knows you're on shift.

voices.speaker: Jozef
voices.text: I see you brought a Walkman. Music helps pass a quiet night, but be careful — with headphones on, you won't hear footsteps coming up behind you. Try them on and take them off.

voices.speaker: Jozef
voices.text: Write everything down. When something goes wrong, paper matters more than memory. Follow me — I'll walk you through your first patrol.

voices.speaker: Jozef
voices.text: Come on. First we check the main entrance gate. People sometimes forget to lock it at night. Inspect the latch and log it in your notebook.

voices.speaker: Jozef
voices.text: Keep to the center walkway between the parked cars. Check the parking lot and garage lane on every single shift.

voices.speaker: Jozef
voices.text: Take a look at this door at Building A. Make sure it's shut and locked — residents leave it propped open. Then log it in your notebook.

voices.speaker: Jozef
voices.text: Stick to the paved path through Central Park. In November fog it's easy to lose your bearings.

voices.speaker: Jozef
voices.text: Martin, come on — don't fall behind in the fog. I'll wait right here for you.

voices.speaker: Jozef
voices.text: Did you hear that? Hold on a second. Sometimes the wind rattles loose metal out here.

voices.speaker: Jozef
voices.text: Check the Newsstand shutters and Night Shop entrance here. Dana has worked this square for years — she notices strangers.

voices.speaker: Jozef
voices.text: Right, that's everything. You can handle the next rounds on your own. Log your notes at the desk and call me on the radio if anything feels off.

voices.speaker: Jozef
voices.text: Someone reported footsteps in an empty flat in Building C. Check it out yourself tonight — I still have paperwork at the main office.

voices.speaker: Martin
voices.text: First night shift at the Javor Estate. The November mist is rolling in off the pines.

voices.speaker: Martin
voices.text: Got it, Mr. Varga. Right behind you.

voices.speaker: Martin
voices.text: Somebody was just down here. Those boot prints are still wet.

voices.speaker: Martin
voices.text: Power's out across the entire estate. I need to reach Room Forty-Seven.

voices.speaker: Anna
voices.text: You're the new night watchman? Milan used to work this estate before you. Quiet man — knew every stairwell lock by heart.

voices.speaker: Anna
voices.text: Last night past midnight someone crossed the yard wearing a dark maintenance coat. I couldn't see his face.

voices.speaker: Anna
voices.text: Be careful around Building B, young man. Folks around here don't like talking about Apartment Forty-Seven.

voices.speaker: Dana
voices.text: Good evening, just closing up. Earlier someone stood by the northern apartment block for ten minutes without going inside.

voices.speaker: Dana
voices.text: Second night in a row somebody slipped down the back delivery alley. Definitely wasn't buying groceries.

voices.speaker: Dana
voices.text: My ceiling lights have been flickering for hours. If you pass the substation, tell Varga to get an electrician out here.

voices.speaker: Milan
voices.text: November twelfth. Someone has been shadowing my patrol. Apartment Forty-Seven isn't a real flat — an old maintenance corridor runs right under it.

voices.speaker: Milan
voices.text: If the new guard finds this tape, I'm still down here past the boiler tunnel. Bring the maintenance key.

voices.speaker: Milan
voices.text: Martin? Thank God. Roman Kral knows every cellar down here. Let's get to the north service gate before he cuts us off.

voices.speaker: Roman
voices.text: You are not walking alone.

voices.speaker: Roman
voices.text: You shouldn't have come down here. Leave those keys and go home.

voices.speaker: Jozef
voices.text: Martin, copy? Check your notebook for the next patrol checkpoint and make sure every door is locked.

voices.speaker: Jozef
voices.text: Shift complete. Return to duty.

voices.speaker: ResM
voices.text: Novy Brod Dispatch, Channel Four. Loud and clear, Martin. Next status check at oh-two-hundred hours.

voices.speaker: Jozef
voices.text: Martin, it's Varga. Leave the old service doors alone tonight and stick strictly to your standard patrol.

voices.speaker: ResM
voices.text: Rain again, my boots never dry out in November. Did you grab bread from the grocery store?

voices.speaker: ResF
voices.text: Good evening, neighbor. That streetlamp by the park is flickering again — I reported it twice already.

voices.speaker: ResM
voices.text: Hey, don't forget to lock the cellar door. Someone left the basement light on all week.

voices.speaker: ResF
voices.text: Good evening, officer. Cold damp night out here, isn't it?

voices.speaker: ResM
voices.text: Turn the television down a little, it's almost eleven and I have an early shift tomorrow.

voices.speaker: ResF
voices.text: Who is walking up the stairs this late? Check the peephole and make sure they shut the entrance door.

voices.speaker: ResM
voices.text: Evening weather report. Heavy fog and cold drizzle will settle across the residential valleys overnight.

voices.speaker: ResF
voices.text: Shut that window, the cold fog and boiler smoke are blowing straight inside.

voices.speaker: Dana
voices.text: Here you go, twenty-four crowns. Fresh bread delivery won't arrive until six in the morning.

voices.speaker: ResF
voices.text: Newspapers are stacked up — just counting the cash drawer and rolling down the shutter.

voices.speaker: Dana
voices.text: Yes, I'm locking up now. I'll be home in half an hour once I check in with the night guard.
